title: Opening: Monday. At the bar
notes: Scene Book, Opening: Monday, section 5. The narration is the Scene Book's: "The bartender sets your usual down before you ask. Nobody here judges you. That's the pull."

The Scene Book says the drinking escape lives here as a place. So the usual is set down here, and the bar's actions (Have your usual, Club soda with lime) are where you choose. Those actions are Claude's drafts in actions.json.
